# Pro Clean Surface Works

> Local pressure washing and exterior surface cleaning company based in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, serving the surrounding parishes. Slogan: "Pressure washing done right."

Pro Clean Surface Works is a locally owned pressure washing company in Baton Rouge, LA. The crew cleans residential and commercial exterior surfaces: driveways, concrete, house siding, sidewalks, walkways, entryways, patios, and storefronts. Hard surfaces are cleaned with high-pressure washing; delicate surfaces like siding and stucco are cleaned with low-pressure soft washing so they are not damaged.

## How they work

- **Free, no-obligation quotes**, usually the same day. Text a photo of the job for a fast price.
- **Local crew** based in Baton Rouge — customers describe them as hard-working and professional.
- **Residential and commercial** service.
- **Up-front pricing** with no hidden fees.

## Services

- Residential pressure washing (driveways, patios, walkways, fences, home exteriors)
- Commercial pressure washing (storefronts, sidewalks, entrances, building exteriors, recurring service)
- House washing / soft washing (siding, brick, stucco — removes mold, mildew, algae)
- Driveway and concrete cleaning (oil stains, mildew, even finish)
- Sidewalk and walkway cleaning (slip hazards, entryways)
- Power washing (full-service exterior cleaning)

## Service area

Baton Rouge and the capital region: Prairieville, Gonzales, Denham Springs, Geismar, Saint Gabriel, Village St. George, and Shenandoah, across East Baton Rouge, Ascension, Livingston, and Iberville parishes.
